func mappingOptionsForTest() options {
	return options{RunID: "mapping-test", SourceSHA: strings.Repeat("a", 40), FixtureNonce: strings.Repeat("b", 64), Volume: fixtureVolume, Phase: "current-smb-cold", Sequence: 3}
}

func TestMappingPowerShellEnvironmentPolicy(t *testing.T) {
	captured, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString("")
	if err != nil || len(captured) != 359 || fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(captured)) != "fd4d6623b1d2dd83d73c5c7d52bb5ec06cb61fd63ad5f1e4d174e19a4d6391d5" {
		t.Fatal("captured parent module-path fixture changed")
	}
	root := `C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\Modules`
	parent := []string{"PSModulePath=" + string(captured), "psMODULEpath=duplicate", "PSMODULEANALYSISCACHEPATH=old", "psmoduleanalysiscachepath=", "Path=C:\\bin", "PATH=second-path-entry", "EMPTY=", "=C:=C:\\work", "WinPSModulePath=preserved", "UNICODE=𝄞"}
	before := append([]string(nil), parent...)
	child, err := mappingPowerShellEnvironment(parent, root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := append(append([]string(nil), parent[4:]...), "PSModulePath="+root, "PSModuleAnalysisCachePath=NUL")
	if value, present := mappingEnvironmentLookup(child, "PSModulePath"); !present || value != root || value == string(captured) {
		t.Fatal("child retained incompatible parent module roots")
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(child, want) || !reflect.DeepEqual(parent, before) {
		t.Fatal("mapping environment changed unrelated entries, retained target aliases, or mutated the parent")
	}
	if value, present := mappingEnvironmentLookup(child, "PSModuleAnalysisCachePath"); !present || value != "NUL" {
		t.Fatal("child cache policy is missing")
	}
	child[0] = "changed-only-in-child"
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(parent, before) {
		t.Fatal("child environment aliases parent storage")
	}
	empty, err := mappingPowerShellEnvironment(nil, root)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(empty, []string{"PSModulePath=" + root, "PSModuleAnalysisCachePath=NUL"}) {
		t.Fatal("empty parent environment policy changed")
	}
	if _, present := mappingEnvironmentLookup(empty, "WinPSModulePath"); present {
		t.Fatal("WinPSModulePath was manufactured")
	}
}

func TestMappingEnvironmentRejectsInvalidEntriesBeforeDelegation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, entry := range []string{"missing-value", "=C:", "==value", "X=private-secret\x00tail", "PSModulePath=private-secret\x00tail", "X=\xff"} {
		parent := []string{entry}
		before := append([]string(nil), parent...)
		result, err := mappingPowerShellEnvironment(parent, "verified-root")
		if result != nil || !errors.Is(err, syscall.EINVAL) || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "private-secret") || !reflect.DeepEqual(parent, before) {
			t.Fatalf("invalid environment handling: %v", err)
		}
	}
	for _, root := range []string{"", "one;two", "private-secret\x00tail", "\xff"} {
		host := &mappingCommandHost{}
		process, err := startMappingPowerShell(host, "system-powershell", []string{"same"}, "private-evidence", root)
		var launch *windowsLaunchError
		if process != nil || err == nil || host.starts != 0 || !errors.As(err, &launch) || !launch.Facts.CleanupConfirmed || launch.Facts.PID != nil || launch.Facts.CreateProcess != nil || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "private-secret") {
			t.Fatalf("invalid root reached process creation or lost error facts: %v", err)
		}
	}
}
func cloneMappingValue[T any](t *testing.T, value T) T {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var copy T
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &copy); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return copy
}
func mappingBaselineForTest() mappingSnapshot {
	snapshot := mappingSnapshot{Owner: mappingOwner{SID: "S-1-5-21-10-20-30-1001", AuthenticationID: "0000000000000123", WindowsBuild: 26100}, Rows: []mappingRow{{LocalPath: "M:", RemotePath: `\\baseline\share`, Status: "OK"}}, Devices: map[string][]string{}, LogicalDrives: 1<<2 | 1<<12}
	for letter := 'A'; letter <= 'Z'; letter++ {
		snapshot.Devices[string(letter)+":"] = nil
	}
	snapshot.Devices["C:"] = []string{`\Device\HarddiskVolume4`}
	snapshot.Devices["M:"] = []string{"baseline opaque mapping"}
	return snapshot
}

type mappingMemoryStore struct {
	t         *testing.T
	o         options
	ledger    mappingLedger
	events    *[]string
	createErr error
	saveErrAt int
	saves     int
}

func (s *mappingMemoryStore) Create(value mappingLedger) error {
	*s.events = append(*s.events, "intent")
	if s.createErr != nil {
		return s.createErr
	}
	if err := validateMappingLedger(value, s.o); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.ledger = cloneMappingValue(s.t, value)
	return nil
}
func (s *mappingMemoryStore) Save(value mappingLedger) error {
	s.saves++
	*s.events = append(*s.events, "save:"+value.State)
	if s.saves == s.saveErrAt {
		return errors.New("ledger sync failed")
	}
	if err := validateMappingLedger(value, s.o); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.ledger = cloneMappingValue(s.t, value)
	return nil
}

type mappingFakeBackend struct {
	t                           *testing.T
	current                     mappingSnapshot
	events                      *[]string
	store                       *mappingMemoryStore
	creates, removes, snapshots int
	createErr                   error
	createResource              bool
	rowOnly                     bool
	removeErr                   error
	leaveResource               bool
	snapshotErrors              map[int]error
	beforeCreate                func()
}

func (b *mappingFakeBackend) Snapshot(context.Context) (mappingSnapshot, error) {
	b.snapshots++
	*b.events = append(*b.events, "snapshot")
	if err := b.snapshotErrors[b.snapshots]; err != nil {
		return mappingSnapshot{}, err
	}
	return cloneMappingValue(b.t, b.current), nil
}
func (b *mappingFakeBackend) Create(ctx context.Context, value mappingLedger) error {
	b.creates++
	*b.events = append(*b.events, "create")
	if b.store.ledger.State != "intent" || b.store.ledger.RemotePath != value.RemotePath {
		b.t.Fatal("native create preceded durable matching intent")
	}
	if b.beforeCreate != nil {
		b.beforeCreate()
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if b.createResource {
		b.current.Rows = append(b.current.Rows, mappingRow{value.LocalPath, value.RemotePath, "OK"})
		if !b.rowOnly {
			b.current.Devices[value.LocalPath] = []string{"opaque target; not a port or SID encoding"}
			b.current.LogicalDrives |= 1 << uint(value.LocalPath[0]-'A')
		}
	}
	return b.createErr
}
func (b *mappingFakeBackend) Remove(_ context.Context, value mappingLedger, row mappingRow) error {
	b.removes++
	*b.events = append(*b.events, "remove")
	if row.LocalPath != value.LocalPath || row.RemotePath != value.RemotePath {
		b.t.Fatal("unrelated mapping removal")
	}
	if b.removeErr != nil {
		return b.removeErr
	}
	if !b.leaveResource {
		rows := []mappingRow{}
		for _, existing := range b.current.Rows {
			if existing.LocalPath != row.LocalPath || existing.RemotePath != row.RemotePath {
				rows = append(rows, existing)
			}
		}
		b.current.Rows = rows
		b.current.Devices[value.LocalPath] = nil
		b.current.LogicalDrives &^= 1 << uint(value.LocalPath[0]-'A')
	}
	return nil
}
func newMappingModel(t *testing.T) (options, *mappingFakeBackend, *mappingMemoryStore) {
	t.Helper()
	o := mappingOptionsForTest()
	events := []string{}
	store := &mappingMemoryStore{t: t, o: o, events: &events}
	backend := &mappingFakeBackend{t: t, current: mappingBaselineForTest(), events: &events, store: store, createResource: true, snapshotErrors: map[int]error{}}
	return o, backend, store
}
func startMappingModel(t *testing.T) (*ownedSMBMapping, *mappingFakeBackend, *mappingMemoryStore) {
	t.Helper()
	o, backend, store := newMappingModel(t)
	mapping, err := beginSMBMapping(context.Background(), o, "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce, 15445, backend, store, "smb-mapping.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return mapping, backend, store
}

func TestMappingDriveSelectionRequiresAllInventories(t *testing.T) {
	snapshot := mappingBaselineForTest()
	snapshot.LogicalDrives |= 1 << 25
	snapshot.Devices["Y:"] = []string{"unrelated DOS target"}
	snapshot.Rows = append(snapshot.Rows, mappingRow{"X:", `\\another\share`, "Unavailable"})
	drive, err := chooseMappingDrive(snapshot)
	if err != nil || drive != "W:" {
		t.Fatalf("drive=%q error=%v", drive, err)
	}
	snapshot.LogicalDrives = (1 << 26) - 1
	if _, err := chooseMappingDrive(snapshot); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("occupied drive adopted")
	}
	for _, change := range []func(*mappingSnapshot){
		func(s *mappingSnapshot) { delete(s.Devices, "A:") },
		func(s *mappingSnapshot) { s.Rows = append(s.Rows, mappingRow{"m:", `\\duplicate\share`, "OK"}) },
		func(s *mappingSnapshot) { s.LogicalDrives |= 1 << 31 },
		func(s *mappingSnapshot) { s.Owner.AuthenticationID = "" },
	} {
		copy := cloneMappingValue(t, mappingBaselineForTest())
		change(&copy)
		if _, err := chooseMappingDrive(copy); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("malformed inventory accepted")
		}
	}
}

func TestMappingIntentPrecedesCreateAndCleanupPreservesBaseline(t *testing.T) {
	mapping, backend, store := startMappingModel(t)
	want := []string{"snapshot", "intent", "create", "save:create-returned", "snapshot", "save:observed"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(*backend.events, want) {
		t.Fatalf("ownership ordering %v", *backend.events)
	}
	if mapping.LocalPath() != "Z:" || store.ledger.State != "observed" || store.ledger.TCPPort != 15445 || !store.ledger.RequireIntegrity || store.ledger.Persistent || store.ledger.Global || store.ledger.SaveCredentials {
		t.Fatal("mapping arguments or observation were lost")
	}
	facts := mapping.Facts()
	facts.DOSDevice[0] = "mutated caller slice"
	if mapping.ledger.ObservedDevice[0] == facts.DOSDevice[0] {
		t.Fatal("facts alias owned ledger")
	}
	if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if backend.creates != 1 || backend.removes != 1 || store.ledger.State != "removed" {
		t.Fatalf("create=%d remove=%d state=%s", backend.creates, backend.removes, store.ledger.State)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(backend.current, mappingBaselineForTest()) {
		t.Fatal("baseline resource changed")
	}
}

func TestMappingLostReplyAndPartialCreationAreCleanupOnly(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"lost-reply", "row-only", "observation-failure"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o, backend, store := newMappingModel(t)
			original := errors.New("first create observation failed")
			if name == "observation-failure" {
				backend.snapshotErrors[2] = original
			} else {
				backend.createErr = original
			}
			backend.rowOnly = name == "row-only"
			mapping, err := beginSMBMapping(context.Background(), o, "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce, 15445, backend, store, "ledger")
			if mapping == nil || !errors.Is(err, original) {
				t.Fatalf("partial ownership or first failure lost: %v %v", mapping, err)
			}
			if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if backend.creates != 1 || backend.removes != 1 || store.ledger.State != "removed" {
				t.Fatalf("creation was replayed or cleanup lost: %d %d %s", backend.creates, backend.removes, store.ledger.State)
			}
			if !errors.Is(err, original) {
				t.Fatal("successful recovery erased original failure")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingUncertainAbsenceRemainsFailure(t *testing.T) {
	o, backend, store := newMappingModel(t)
	backend.createErr = errors.New("lost reply")
	backend.createResource = false
	mapping, err := beginSMBMapping(context.Background(), o, "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce, 15445, backend, store, "ledger")
	if mapping == nil || err == nil {
		t.Fatal("lost reply reported success")
	}
	if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "unknown") {
		t.Fatalf("absence fabricated quiescence: %v", err)
	}
	if backend.removes != 0 || store.ledger.State != "intent" {
		t.Fatal("unproven absence became clean")
	}
}

func TestMappingForeignBindingsAreNeverRemoved(t *testing.T) {
	cases := map[string]func(*ownedSMBMapping, *mappingFakeBackend){
		"SID":   func(_ *ownedSMBMapping, b *mappingFakeBackend) { b.current.Owner.SID = "S-1-5-21-10-20-30-2002" },
		"logon": func(_ *ownedSMBMapping, b *mappingFakeBackend) { b.current.Owner.AuthenticationID = "0000000000000999" },
		"foreign-row": func(m *ownedSMBMapping, b *mappingFakeBackend) {
			b.current.Rows[len(b.current.Rows)-1].RemotePath = `\\foreign\share`
		},
		"different-drive": func(m *ownedSMBMapping, b *mappingFakeBackend) {
			b.current.Rows[len(b.current.Rows)-1].LocalPath = "Y:"
		},
		"DOS-target": func(m *ownedSMBMapping, b *mappingFakeBackend) {
			b.current.Devices[m.LocalPath()] = []string{"different target"}
		},
		"baseline-row": func(_ *ownedSMBMapping, b *mappingFakeBackend) { b.current.Rows = b.current.Rows[1:] },
		"baseline-device": func(_ *ownedSMBMapping, b *mappingFakeBackend) {
			b.current.Devices["M:"] = []string{"changed baseline"}
		},
		"rowless-device": func(_ *ownedSMBMapping, b *mappingFakeBackend) { b.current.Rows = b.current.Rows[:1] },
		"rowless-logical-drive": func(m *ownedSMBMapping, b *mappingFakeBackend) {
			b.current.Rows = b.current.Rows[:1]
			b.current.Devices[m.LocalPath()] = nil
		},
		"recovered-device-change": func(m *ownedSMBMapping, b *mappingFakeBackend) {
			m.ledger.State = "intent"
			b.current.Devices[m.LocalPath()] = []string{"new recovery target"}
		},
	}
	for name, change := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			mapping, backend, _ := startMappingModel(t)
			change(mapping, backend)
			if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("mismatched mapping cleanup passed")
			}
			if backend.removes != 0 {
				t.Fatal("mismatched resource was removed")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingNoAdoptionNoReappearanceAndNoMissingRemovalProof(t *testing.T) {
	o, backend, store := newMappingModel(t)
	backend.current.Rows = append(backend.current.Rows, mappingRow{"", `\\127.0.0.1\rfs-` + o.FixtureNonce, "OK"})
	if mapping, err := beginSMBMapping(context.Background(), o, "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce, 15445, backend, store, "ledger"); mapping != nil || err == nil || backend.creates != 0 {
		t.Fatal("existing nonce share adopted")
	}
	mapping, backend, store := startMappingModel(t)
	backend.current = cloneMappingValue(t, mapping.ledger.Baseline)
	if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if backend.removes != 0 || store.ledger.State != "removed" {
		t.Fatal("confirmed absence required a deletion")
	}
	backend.current.Rows = append(backend.current.Rows, mappingRow{mapping.LocalPath(), mapping.ledger.RemotePath, "OK"})
	if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err == nil || backend.removes != 0 {
		t.Fatal("reappeared resource adopted")
	}
	mapping, backend, _ = startMappingModel(t)
	backend.leaveResource = true
	if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("remove reply substituted for row/device absence")
	}
}

func TestMappingPersistenceFailureNeverStartsAnUnrecordedCreate(t *testing.T) {
	for _, afterCreate := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(afterCreate), func(t *testing.T) {
			o, backend, store := newMappingModel(t)
			if afterCreate {
				store.saveErrAt = 1
			} else {
				store.createErr = errors.New("intent write failed")
			}
			mapping, err := beginSMBMapping(context.Background(), o, "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce, 15445, backend, store, "ledger")
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("failed persistence ignored")
			}
			if !afterCreate {
				if mapping != nil || backend.creates != 0 {
					t.Fatal("create ran without intent")
				}
				return
			}
			if mapping == nil || backend.creates != 1 {
				t.Fatal("partial ownership lost after create")
			}
			if err := mapping.cleanup(context.Background()); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		})
	}
	o, backend, store := newMappingModel(t)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	if mapping, err := beginSMBMapping(ctx, o, "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce, 15445, backend, store, "ledger"); mapping != nil || !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || backend.creates != 0 || store.ledger.State != "" {
		t.Fatal("canceled invocation acquired resources")
	}
}

func TestMappingLedgerRejectsForeignAndBaselineOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	mapping, _, _ := startMappingModel(t)
	o := mapping.options
	for name, change := range map[string]func(*mappingLedger){
		"source":         func(l *mappingLedger) { l.SourceSHA = strings.Repeat("c", 40) },
		"nonce":          func(l *mappingLedger) { l.Nonce = strings.Repeat("c", 64) },
		"zero-sequence":  func(l *mappingLedger) { l.Sequence = 0 },
		"sequence":       func(l *mappingLedger) { l.Sequence++ },
		"drive":          func(l *mappingLedger) { l.LocalPath = "C:" },
		"port":           func(l *mappingLedger) { l.TCPPort = 0 },
		"persistent":     func(l *mappingLedger) { l.Persistent = true },
		"global":         func(l *mappingLedger) { l.Global = true },
		"credentials":    func(l *mappingLedger) { l.SaveCredentials = true },
		"unsigned":       func(l *mappingLedger) { l.RequireIntegrity = false },
		"owner":          func(l *mappingLedger) { l.Owner.AuthenticationID = "0000000000000999" },
		"baseline-drive": func(l *mappingLedger) { l.Baseline.Devices[l.LocalPath] = []string{"baseline"} },
		"baseline-share": func(l *mappingLedger) { l.Baseline.Rows = append(l.Baseline.Rows, mappingRow{"", l.RemotePath, "OK"}) },
		"observation":    func(l *mappingLedger) { l.ObservedRow.RemotePath = `\\other\share` },
		"unknown-state":  func(l *mappingLedger) { l.State = "ready" },
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ledger := cloneMappingValue(t, mapping.ledger)
			change(&ledger)
			if err := validateMappingLedger(ledger, o); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid ledger accepted")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingRecoveryRequiresCreationSequence(t *testing.T) {
	mapping, _, _ := startMappingModel(t)
	cleanup := mapping.options
	cleanup.Phase = "current-smb-cleanup"
	if err := validateMappingLedger(mapping.ledger, cleanup); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("cleanup changed only phase and lost its owned ledger: %v", err)
	}
	cleanup.Sequence++
	if err := validateMappingLedger(mapping.ledger, cleanup); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("cleanup adopted a ledger from a different sequence")
	}
}

func TestMappingJSONRejectsAmbiguityAndBounds(t *testing.T) {
	for _, data := range []string{`{"status":"ok","status":"error"}`, `{"rows":[{"local_path":"X:","local_path":"Y:"}]}`, `{} {}`, strings.Repeat("[", 18) + strings.Repeat("]", 18), strings.Repeat(" ", mappingByteLimit+1)} {
		var value mappingCommandResult
		if err := decodeMappingJSON([]byte(data), &value); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("ambiguous mapping JSON accepted: %.80s", data)
		}
	}
	var output mappingBoundedBuffer
	if n, err := output.Write(make([]byte, mappingByteLimit)); err != nil || n != mappingByteLimit {
		t.Fatal(n, err)
	}
	if _, err := output.Write([]byte{1}); err == nil || output.Len() != mappingByteLimit {
		t.Fatal("output overflow accepted")
	}
}

type mappingInputBuffer struct {
	bytes.Buffer
	closes int
}

func (b *mappingInputBuffer) Close() error { b.closes++; return nil }

type mappingUtilityTestInfo struct {
	size     int64
	mode     os.FileMode
	modified time.Time
}

func (i mappingUtilityTestInfo) Name() string       { return "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility.psd1" }
func (i mappingUtilityTestInfo) Size() int64        { return i.size }
func (i mappingUtilityTestInfo) Mode() os.FileMode  { return i.mode }
func (i mappingUtilityTestInfo) ModTime() time.Time { return i.modified }
func (i mappingUtilityTestInfo) IsDir() bool        { return i.mode.IsDir() }
func (i mappingUtilityTestInfo) Sys() any           { return nil }

type mappingUtilityTestFile struct {
	reader                          io.Reader
	info, afterInfo                 os.FileInfo
	statErr, afterStatErr, closeErr error
	statCalls, closes               int
	onClose                         func()
}

func (f *mappingUtilityTestFile) Read(data []byte) (int, error) { return f.reader.Read(data) }
func (f *mappingUtilityTestFile) Stat() (os.FileInfo, error) {
	f.statCalls++
	if f.statCalls > 1 && (f.afterInfo != nil || f.afterStatErr != nil) {
		return f.afterInfo, f.afterStatErr
	}
	return f.info, f.statErr
}
func (f *mappingUtilityTestFile) Close() error {
	f.closes++
	if f.onClose != nil {
		f.onClose()
	}
	return f.closeErr
}

type mappingUtilityTestReader func([]byte) (int, error)

func (r mappingUtilityTestReader) Read(data []byte) (int, error) { return r(data) }

const mappingUtilityTestData = "verified Utility manifest bytes"

func mappingUtilityRootForTest(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	return mappingStartupManifestForTest(t, "modules")
}

func mappingUtilityOpsForTest() mappingUtilityOps {
	return mappingUtilityOps{
		CheckPath: func(string) error { return nil },
		Open: func(string) (mappingUtilityFile, error) {
			return &mappingUtilityTestFile{reader: strings.NewReader(mappingUtilityTestData), info: mappingUtilityTestInfo{size: int64(len(mappingUtilityTestData))}}, nil
		},
		CommandLine: func(args []string) string { return strings.Join(args, " ") },
	}
}

type mappingCommandChild struct {
	input          *mappingInputBuffer
	inputOverride  io.WriteCloser
	output, stderr io.ReadCloser
	done           chan struct{}
	result         error
	forced         bool
	finished       int
	closePipes     func()
	finishErr      error
	resultCalls    int
}

func (p *mappingCommandChild) Input() io.WriteCloser {
	if p.inputOverride != nil {
		return p.inputOverride
	}
	return p.input
}
func (p *mappingCommandChild) Output() io.ReadCloser { return p.output }
func (p *mappingCommandChild) Errors() io.ReadCloser { return p.stderr }
func (p *mappingCommandChild) Done() <-chan struct{} { return p.done }
func (p *mappingCommandChild) Result() error {
	select {
	case <-p.done:
	default:
		panic("Result called before Done")
	}
	p.resultCalls++
	return p.result
}
func (p *mappingCommandChild) PID() uint32 { return 55 }
func (p *mappingCommandChild) Finish() (bool, error) {
	p.finished++
	if p.closePipes != nil {
		p.closePipes()
	}
	return p.forced, errors.Join(p.finishErr, p.Input().Close(), p.output.Close(), p.stderr.Close())
}

type mappingCommandHost struct {
	child              *mappingCommandChild
	args               []string
	starts             int
	cache              string
	environment        []string
	startErr           error
	returnChildOnError bool
	onStart            func()
}

func (h *mappingCommandHost) Preflight() (map[string]any, error) { return nil, nil }
func (h *mappingCommandHost) StartWithEnvironment(_ string, args []string, _ string, environment []string) (child, error) {
	h.starts++
	if h.onStart != nil {
		h.onStart()
	}
	h.args = append([]string(nil), args...)
	h.environment = append([]string(nil), environment...)
	h.cache, _ = mappingEnvironmentLookup(environment, "PSModuleAnalysisCachePath")
	if h.startErr != nil {
		if h.returnChildOnError {
			return h.child, h.startErr
		}
		return nil, h.startErr
	}
	return h.child, nil
}

func TestMappingUtilityPreparationFailureRefusesLaunch(t *testing.T) {
	pathFailure, statFailure, readFailure, closeFailure := errors.New("reparse ancestor"), errors.New("stat failed"), errors.New("read failed"), errors.New("close failed")
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name      string
		configure func(*mappingUtilityOps, *mappingUtilityTestFile)
		causes    []error
		closes    int
		clean     bool
	}{
		{"missing", func(o *mappingUtilityOps, _ *mappingUtilityTestFile) {
			o.Open = func(string) (mappingUtilityFile, error) { return nil, os.ErrNotExist }
		}, []error{os.ErrNotExist}, 0, true},
		{"reparse", func(o *mappingUtilityOps, _ *mappingUtilityTestFile) {
			o.CheckPath = func(string) error { return pathFailure }
		}, []error{pathFailure}, 0, true},
		{"open-with-handle", func(o *mappingUtilityOps, f *mappingUtilityTestFile) {
			o.Open = func(string) (mappingUtilityFile, error) { return f, os.ErrPermission }
			f.closeErr = closeFailure
		}, []error{os.ErrPermission, closeFailure}, 1, false},
		{"no-handle", func(o *mappingUtilityOps, _ *mappingUtilityTestFile) {
			o.Open = func(string) (mappingUtilityFile, error) { return nil, nil }
		}, nil, 0, true},
		{"stat", func(_ *mappingUtilityOps, f *mappingUtilityTestFile) { f.statErr = statFailure }, []error{statFailure}, 1, true},
		{"second-stat", func(_ *mappingUtilityOps, f *mappingUtilityTestFile) { f.afterStatErr = statFailure }, []error{statFailure}, 1, true},
		{"read-and-close", func(_ *mappingUtilityOps, f *mappingUtilityTestFile) {
			f.reader = mappingUtilityTestReader(func([]byte) (int, error) { return 0, readFailure })
			f.closeErr = closeFailure
		}, []error{readFailure, closeFailure}, 1, false},
		{"close", func(_ *mappingUtilityOps, f *mappingUtilityTestFile) { f.closeErr = closeFailure }, []error{closeFailure}, 1, false},
		{"directory", func(_ *mappingUtilityOps, f *mappingUtilityTestFile) {
			f.info = mappingUtilityTestInfo{mode: os.ModeDir}
		}, nil, 1, true},
		{"nonregular", func(_ *mappingUtilityOps, f *mappingUtilityTestFile) {
			f.info = mappingUtilityTestInfo{mode: os.ModeSymlink}
		}, nil, 1, true},
		{"negative-size", func(_ *mappingUtilityOps, f *mappingUtilityTestFile) { f.info = mappingUtilityTestInfo{size: -1} }, nil, 1, true},
		{"oversized-stat", func(_ *mappingUtilityOps, f *mappingUtilityTestFile) {
			f.info = mappingUtilityTestInfo{size: mappingByteLimit + 1}
		}, nil, 1, true},
		{"oversized-read", func(_ *mappingUtilityOps, f *mappingUtilityTestFile) {
			f.reader = strings.NewReader(strings.Repeat("x", mappingByteLimit+1))
		}, nil, 1, true},
		{"size-changed", func(_ *mappingUtilityOps, f *mappingUtilityTestFile) { f.afterInfo = mappingUtilityTestInfo{size: 1} }, nil, 1, true},
		{"mtime-changed", func(_ *mappingUtilityOps, f *mappingUtilityTestFile) {
			f.afterInfo = mappingUtilityTestInfo{size: int64(len(mappingUtilityTestData)), modified: time.Unix(1, 0)}
		}, nil, 1, true},
		{"commandline-too-long", func(o *mappingUtilityOps, _ *mappingUtilityTestFile) {
			o.CommandLine = func([]string) string { return strings.Repeat("x", 32767) }
		}, nil, 1, true},
		{"commandline-nul", func(o *mappingUtilityOps, _ *mappingUtilityTestFile) {
			o.CommandLine = func([]string) string { return "invalid\x00command" }
		}, nil, 1, true},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			file := &mappingUtilityTestFile{reader: strings.NewReader(mappingUtilityTestData), info: mappingUtilityTestInfo{size: int64(len(mappingUtilityTestData))}}
			ops := mappingUtilityOpsForTest()
			ops.Open = func(string) (mappingUtilityFile, error) { return file, nil }
			test.configure(&ops, file)
			host := &mappingCommandHost{startErr: errors.New("unexpected child launch")}
			execution, err := executePreparedMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), host, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory"}, true, ops)
			d := execution.Diagnostic
			if err == nil || host.starts != 0 || d.UtilityPreparation == nil || d.CleanupConfirmed != test.clean || d.UtilityPreparation.CleanupConfirmed != test.clean || file.closes != test.closes {
				t.Fatalf("preparation failure escaped launch/cleanup ownership: starts=%d closes=%d facts=%+v error=%v", host.starts, file.closes, d.UtilityPreparation, err)
			}
			if d.Action != "inventory" || !d.EOFRequested || d.PID != nil || d.Launch != nil || d.WorkersStarted != 0 || d.WorkersJoined != 0 ||
				d.InputBytes != 0 || d.InputSHA256 != "" || d.InputLineBytes != 0 || d.InputLineSHA256 != "" || d.ScriptUTF16Units != 0 || d.ScriptSHA256 != "" || d.WriteStarted {
				t.Fatal("failed preparation fabricated process, input or script observations")
			}
			for _, cause := range test.causes {
				if !errors.Is(err, cause) {
					t.Fatalf("preparation lost its cause: %v", err)
				}
			}
			if len(test.causes) > 1 && !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), test.causes[0].Error()) {
				t.Fatal("cleanup error replaced the first preparation error")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingPreparedExecutionKeepsOriginalDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	for _, phase := range []string{"before", "path", "open", "read", "commandline", "close"} {
		t.Run(phase, func(t *testing.T) {
			base, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 4*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			ctx := mappingTestDeadline{Context: base}
			deadline, _ := ctx.Deadline()
			if phase == "before" {
				cancel()
			}
			checks, opens := 0, 0
			reader := strings.NewReader(mappingUtilityTestData)
			file := &mappingUtilityTestFile{reader: reader, info: mappingUtilityTestInfo{size: int64(len(mappingUtilityTestData))}}
			file.reader = mappingUtilityTestReader(func(data []byte) (int, error) {
				if phase == "read" {
					cancel()
				}
				return reader.Read(data)
			})
			file.onClose = func() {
				if phase == "close" {
					cancel()
				}
			}
			ops := mappingUtilityOpsForTest()
			ops.CheckPath = func(string) error {
				checks++
				if phase == "path" {
					cancel()
				}
				return nil
			}
			ops.Open = func(string) (mappingUtilityFile, error) {
				opens++
				if phase == "open" {
					cancel()
				}
				return file, nil
			}
			ops.CommandLine = func(args []string) string {
				if phase == "commandline" {
					cancel()
				}
				return strings.Join(args, " ")
			}
			host := &mappingCommandHost{startErr: errors.New("expired preparation launched a child")}
			execution, err := executePreparedMappingPowerShell(ctx, host, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory"}, false, ops)
			remainingDeadline, _ := ctx.Deadline()
			if !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || host.starts != 0 || !remainingDeadline.Equal(deadline) || execution.Diagnostic.UtilityPreparation == nil || !execution.Diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed {
				t.Fatalf("preparation restarted or lost its original budget: starts=%d error=%v", host.starts, err)
			}
			if phase == "before" && checks != 0 || (phase == "before" || phase == "path") && opens != 0 || file.closes != opens {
				t.Fatal("expired preparation performed later work or leaked an opened file")
			}
		})
	}
}

func mappingScriptFromArgumentsForTest(t *testing.T, args []string) string {
	t.Helper()
	if len(args) != 7 || !reflect.DeepEqual(args[:6], []string{"-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-EncodedCommand"}) {
		t.Fatal("prepared mapping changed PowerShell invocation flags")
	}
	data, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(args[6])
	if err != nil || len(data)%2 != 0 {
		t.Fatal("prepared mapping command is not UTF-16LE base64")
	}
	words := make([]uint16, len(data)/2)
	for index := range words {
		words[index] = binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[2*index:])
	}
	return string(utf16.Decode(words))
}

func TestMappingPreparedNormalAndInventoryUseSameScript(t *testing.T) {
	request := mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", Module: "SmbShare.psd1", OwnerSID: mappingBaselineForTest().Owner.SID}
	reply, err := json.Marshal(mappingCommandResult{Status: "ok", OwnerSID: request.OwnerSID, Rows: []mappingRow{}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	root := mappingUtilityRootForTest(t)
	wantPath := filepath.Join(root, "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility", "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility.psd1")
	wantScript, err := mappingPowerShellScript(wantPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var scripts, frames []string
	for _, mode := range []string{"normal", "inventory-open", "inventory-eof"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			var order []string
			file := &mappingUtilityTestFile{reader: strings.NewReader(mappingUtilityTestData), info: mappingUtilityTestInfo{size: int64(len(mappingUtilityTestData))}, onClose: func() { order = append(order, "close") }}
			ops := mappingUtilityOpsForTest()
			ops.CheckPath = func(path string) error {
				order = append(order, "check")
				if path != wantPath {
					t.Fatal("preparation selected a different manifest")
				}
				return nil
			}
			ops.Open = func(path string) (mappingUtilityFile, error) {
				order = append(order, "open")
				if path != wantPath {
					t.Fatal("preparation opened a different manifest")
				}
				return file, nil
			}
			ops.CommandLine = func(args []string) string {
				order = append(order, "commandline")
				if args[0] != "system-powershell" || mappingScriptFromArgumentsForTest(t, args[1:]) != wantScript {
					t.Fatal("command-line validation did not bind the generated mapping script")
				}
				return strings.Join(args, " ")
			}
			process := mappingReplyChild(string(reply))
			process.inputOverride = &ownedProcessInput{pipe: process.input}
			host := &mappingCommandHost{child: process, onStart: func() {
				order = append(order, "start")
				if file.closes != 1 {
					t.Fatal("child started before checked manifest closure")
				}
			}}
			if mode == "normal" {
				result, err := runMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), host, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", root, request, ops)
				if err != nil || result.Status != "ok" {
					t.Fatalf("normal prepared mapping failed: %v", err)
				}
			} else {
				execution, err := executePreparedMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), host, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", root, request, mode == "inventory-eof", ops)
				facts := execution.Diagnostic.UtilityPreparation
				if err != nil || facts == nil || facts.Path != wantPath || facts.Size == nil || *facts.Size != int64(len(mappingUtilityTestData)) || facts.ReadBytes != len(mappingUtilityTestData) || facts.SHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(mappingUtilityTestData))) || facts.ElapsedNanos < 0 || !facts.CleanupConfirmed || !execution.Diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed {
					t.Fatalf("inventory lost prepared execution facts: %+v %v", facts, err)
				}
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(order, []string{"check", "open", "commandline", "close", "start"}) || file.statCalls != 2 || file.closes != 1 || host.starts != 1 || process.finished != 1 || process.input.closes != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("prepared execution ordering changed: %v", order)
			}
			scripts = append(scripts, mappingScriptFromArgumentsForTest(t, host.args))
			frames = append(frames, process.input.String())
		})
	}
	for index := range scripts {
		if scripts[index] != wantScript || frames[index] != frames[0] {
			t.Fatal("normal mapping and diagnostic inventories used different scripts or input")
		}
	}
}

func TestMappingPreparedFailuresRetainUtilityFactsAndErrorChains(t *testing.T) {
	request := mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", OwnerSID: mappingBaselineForTest().Owner.SID}
	reply, err := json.Marshal(mappingCommandResult{Status: "ok", OwnerSID: request.OwnerSID, Rows: []mappingRow{}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, phase := range []string{"preparation", "launch", "child", "cleanup"} {
		t.Run(phase, func(t *testing.T) {
			failure, closeFailure := errors.New("original phase failure"), errors.New("manifest close failure")
			file := &mappingUtilityTestFile{reader: strings.NewReader(mappingUtilityTestData), info: mappingUtilityTestInfo{size: int64(len(mappingUtilityTestData))}}
			ops := mappingUtilityOpsForTest()
			ops.Open = func(string) (mappingUtilityFile, error) { return file, nil }
			process := mappingReplyChild(string(reply))
			host := &mappingCommandHost{child: process}
			switch phase {
			case "preparation":
				file.reader = mappingUtilityTestReader(func([]byte) (int, error) { return 0, failure })
				file.closeErr = closeFailure
			case "launch":
				host.startErr = &windowsLaunchError{Facts: windowsLaunchFacts{RequestedImage: "system-powershell", CleanupConfirmed: true}, Cause: failure}
			case "child":
				process.result = failure
			case "cleanup":
				process.finishErr = failure
			}
			_, err := runMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), host, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), request, ops)
			if !errors.Is(err, failure) || phase == "preparation" && !errors.Is(err, closeFailure) || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), failure.Error()) {
				t.Fatalf("prepared mapping replaced an original or cleanup error: %v", err)
			}
			d := mappingDiagnosticFrom(t, err).details
			facts := d.UtilityPreparation
			wantClean := phase == "launch" || phase == "child"
			if facts == nil || facts.Path == "" || facts.CleanupConfirmed != (phase != "preparation") || d.CleanupConfirmed != wantClean || file.closes != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("failure lost Utility facts or combined cleanup truth: %+v", d)
			}
			if phase == "preparation" {
				if host.starts != 0 || d.ScriptUTF16Units != 0 || d.PID != nil || d.Launch != nil || d.WorkersStarted != 0 {
					t.Fatal("preparation failure fabricated execution facts")
				}
			} else if host.starts != 1 || facts.ReadBytes != len(mappingUtilityTestData) || facts.SHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(mappingUtilityTestData))) {
				t.Fatal("later failure lost completed manifest observations")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingExecutionInputCompletion(t *testing.T) {
	writeFailure, closeFailure := errors.New("write failed"), errors.New("input close failed")
	for _, mode := range []string{"open", "eof", "short", "write-error", "close-error"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			process := mappingReplyChild("fixed-result\n")
			writes, closes, closeBeforeFinish := 0, 0, false
			process.inputOverride = &ownedProcessInput{pipe: mappingDiagnosticInput{
				write: func(data []byte) (int, error) {
					writes++
					if mode == "short" {
						return len(data) - 1, nil
					}
					if mode == "write-error" {
						return 2, writeFailure
					}
					return len(data), nil
				},
				close: func() error {
					closes++
					closeBeforeFinish = process.finished == 0
					if mode == "close-error" {
						return closeFailure
					}
					return nil
				},
			}}
			request := mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", OwnerSID: "owner"}
			execution, err := executeMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), &mappingCommandHost{child: process}, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", "verified-system-modules", request, mappingStartupEntryScript, mode != "open")
			d := execution.Diagnostic
			if writes != 1 || closes != 1 || process.finished != 1 || d.WorkersStarted != 3 || d.WorkersJoined != 3 || !d.CleanupAttempted {
				t.Fatalf("ownership counts: writes=%d closes=%d finish=%d facts=%+v", writes, closes, process.finished, d)
			}
			wantEOF := mode == "eof" || mode == "close-error"
			if d.EOFAttempted != wantEOF || closeBeforeFinish != wantEOF || d.EOFCompleted != (mode == "eof") {
				t.Fatalf("EOF ordering: %+v", d)
			}
			if d.CleanupConfirmed != (mode != "close-error") {
				t.Fatalf("cleanup fact: %+v", d)
			}
			if mode == "short" && !errors.Is(err, io.ErrShortWrite) || mode == "write-error" && !errors.Is(err, writeFailure) || mode == "close-error" && !errors.Is(err, closeFailure) {
				t.Fatalf("lost operation error: %v", err)
			}
			if (mode == "open" || mode == "eof") && (err != nil || !d.WriteComplete || string(execution.Stdout) != "fixed-result\n") {
				t.Fatalf("normal execution: %+v %v", execution, err)
			}
			if len(d.InputSHA256) != 64 || len(d.ScriptSHA256) != 64 || d.ScriptUTF16Units == 0 || d.Stdout.ObservedBytes != int64(len("fixed-result\n")) {
				t.Fatalf("success observations missing: %+v", d)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingInputLineDiagnosticBindsDeliveredFrame(t *testing.T) {
	sid := mappingBaselineForTest().Owner.SID
	maximum := mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", OwnerSID: sid}
	base, err := json.Marshal(maximum)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	maximum.Module = strings.Repeat("x", 4095-len(base))
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name    string
		request mappingCommandRequest
	}{
		{"ascii", mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", Module: "system-module", OwnerSID: sid}},
		{"unicode-and-escaped-newline", mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", Module: "模块🧪\r\nmanifest", OwnerSID: sid}},
		{"empty-fields", mappingCommandRequest{}},
		{"maximum-line", maximum},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			line, err := json.Marshal(test.request)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			frame := append(append([]byte(nil), line...), '\n')
			lineDigest := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(line))
			frameDigest := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(frame))
			for _, failed := range []bool{false, true} {
				name := "success"
				var failure error
				if failed {
					name, failure = "child-failure", errors.New("child failed after input")
				}
				t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
					process := mappingReplyChild("fixed-result\n")
					process.result = failure
					execution, err := executePreparedMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), &mappingCommandHost{child: process}, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), test.request, false, mappingUtilityOpsForTest())
					if !errors.Is(err, failure) {
						t.Fatalf("execution result changed: %v", err)
					}
					d := execution.Diagnostic
					if !bytes.Equal([]byte(process.input.String()), frame) || d.InputBytes != len(frame) || d.InputSHA256 != frameDigest ||
						d.InputLineBytes != len(line) || d.InputLineSHA256 != lineDigest || d.InputLineSHA256 == d.InputSHA256 {
						t.Fatal("input observation confused the JSON line with its LF-delimited frame")
					}
					if !d.WriteComplete || d.WriteBytes != len(frame) || d.EOFRequested || d.EOFAttempted ||
						d.WorkersJoined != 3 || !d.CleanupConfirmed || process.finished != 1 || process.input.closes != 1 {
						t.Fatal("input observation changed delivery, stdin ownership or worker cleanup")
					}
					if test.name == "maximum-line" && (d.InputLineBytes != 4095 || d.InputBytes != 4096) {
						t.Fatal("maximum input fixture no longer reaches the wire boundary")
					}
					encoded, err := json.Marshal(d)
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					var wire struct {
						LineBytes  int    `json:"input_line_bytes"`
						LineDigest string `json:"input_line_sha256"`
						FrameBytes int    `json:"input_bytes"`
						FrameHash  string `json:"input_sha256"`
					}
					if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &wire); err != nil || wire.LineBytes != len(line) || wire.LineDigest != lineDigest ||
						wire.FrameBytes != len(frame) || wire.FrameHash != frameDigest {
						t.Fatal("diagnostic JSON omitted or renamed the line/frame facts")
					}
					mappingDiagnosticFrom(t, encodeMappingDiagnostic(d))
				})
			}
		})
	}
}

type mappingErrorReader struct{ cause error }

func (r mappingErrorReader) Read([]byte) (int, error) { return 0, r.cause }

func TestMappingExecutionRetainsChildStreamAndCleanupErrors(t *testing.T) {
	childFailure, streamFailure, cleanupFailure := errors.New("child failed"), errors.New("stream failed"), errors.New("cleanup failed")
	for _, mode := range []string{"stream", "validation", "cleanup"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			process := mappingReplyChild(`{"status":"ok","owner_sid":"foreign","rows":[],"cause":""}`)
			process.result = childFailure
			if mode == "stream" {
				process.output = io.NopCloser(mappingErrorReader{streamFailure})
			}
			if mode == "cleanup" {
				process.finishErr = cleanupFailure
			}
			_, err := runMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), &mappingCommandHost{child: process}, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", OwnerSID: "owner"}, mappingUtilityOpsForTest())
			if !errors.Is(err, childFailure) || mode == "stream" && !errors.Is(err, streamFailure) || mode == "cleanup" && !errors.Is(err, cleanupFailure) {
				t.Fatalf("lost error chain: %v", err)
			}
			if process.finished != 1 || mappingDiagnosticFrom(t, err).details.WorkersJoined != 3 {
				t.Fatal("failure escaped owned cleanup")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingExecutionRetainsPartialLaunchAndReturnedChild(t *testing.T) {
	cause := errors.New("resume failed")
	count := uint32(2)
	facts := windowsLaunchFacts{RequestedImage: "system-powershell", PreviousSuspendCount: &count, CleanupConfirmed: true}
	host := &mappingCommandHost{startErr: &windowsLaunchError{Facts: facts, Cause: cause}}
	execution, err := executeMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), host, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", "verified-system-modules", mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory"}, mappingStartupEntryScript, false)
	if !errors.Is(err, cause) || execution.Diagnostic.Launch == nil || *execution.Diagnostic.Launch.PreviousSuspendCount != 2 || execution.Diagnostic.Launch.ActualImage != "" || !execution.Diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed {
		t.Fatalf("partial launch facts: %+v %v", execution, err)
	}
	process := mappingReplyChild("")
	host = &mappingCommandHost{child: process, startErr: cause, returnChildOnError: true}
	execution, err = executeMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), host, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", "verified-system-modules", mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory"}, mappingStartupEntryScript, false)
	if !errors.Is(err, cause) || process.finished != 1 || !execution.Diagnostic.CleanupAttempted || !execution.Diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed || execution.Diagnostic.WorkersStarted != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("returned child escaped start-error cleanup: %+v %v", execution, err)
	}
}

func TestMappingStartupCellsOrderAndCleanupAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	request := mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", Module: "same-module", OwnerSID: "same-owner"}
	wantPlan := [6]mappingStartupCell{
		{Name: "01_entry_open", Kind: mappingStartupEntry, Script: mappingStartupEntryScript, CloseInput: false, Entry: "RFS-MAPPING/1 entry-only", Result: `{"status":"entry-ok"}`},
		{Name: "02_entry_eof", Kind: mappingStartupEntry, Script: mappingStartupEntryScript, CloseInput: true, Entry: "RFS-MAPPING/1 entry-only", Result: `{"status":"entry-ok"}`},
		{Name: "03_inventory_open", Kind: mappingStartupInventory, Script: "", CloseInput: false, Entry: "RFS-MAPPING/1 entry", Result: ""},
		{Name: "04_inventory_eof", Kind: mappingStartupInventory, Script: "", CloseInput: true, Entry: "RFS-MAPPING/1 entry", Result: ""},
		{Name: "05_resolve_json_command", Kind: mappingStartupResolve, Script: mappingStartupResolveScript, CloseInput: false, Entry: "RFS-CMD/1 entry resolve", Result: `{"status":"resolve-ok"}`},
		{Name: "06_import_utility_parse", Kind: mappingStartupImport, Script: "", CloseInput: false, Entry: "RFS-CMD/1 entry import-parse", Result: `{"status":"import-parse-ok"}`},
	}
	if got := mappingStartupPlan(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantPlan) {
		t.Fatal("startup diagnostic differs from the six explicit descriptors")
	}
	for _, failCleanupAt := range []int{0, 2, 4, 5} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("cleanup-failure-at-%d", failCleanupAt), func(t *testing.T) {
			var names, inputHashes []string
			starts, failures, preparations, mappingChecks := 0, 0, 0, 0
			aborted := walkMappingStartupCells(func(ordinal int, cell mappingStartupCell) bool {
				names = append(names, cell.Name)
				if ordinal != len(names) || cell != wantPlan[ordinal-1] {
					t.Fatal("cell order or explicit descriptor changed")
				}
				if cell.Kind == mappingStartupImport {
					preparations++
					var err error
					cell.Script, err = mappingStartupImportScript(mappingStartupManifestForTest(t, "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility.psd1"))
					if err != nil || cell.Script == "" {
						t.Fatal("deferred import cell did not produce its explicit script")
					}
				}
				process := mappingReplyChild("fixed\n")
				process.inputOverride = &ownedProcessInput{pipe: process.input}
				process.forced = ordinal == 1
				if ordinal == 5 {
					process.result = errors.New("resolution failed with known cleanup")
				}
				if ordinal == failCleanupAt {
					process.finishErr = errors.New("job empty not confirmed")
				}
				host := &mappingCommandHost{child: process}
				var execution mappingExecution
				var err error
				if cell.Kind == mappingStartupInventory {
					ops := mappingUtilityOpsForTest()
					ops.CheckPath = func(string) error { mappingChecks++; return nil }
					execution, err = executePreparedMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), host, "same-executable", "same-directory", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), request, cell.CloseInput, ops)
				} else {
					execution, err = executeMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), host, "same-executable", "same-directory", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), request, cell.Script, cell.CloseInput)
				}
				starts += host.starts
				if err != nil {
					failures++
				}
				if process.finished != 1 || execution.Diagnostic.WorkersJoined != 3 {
					t.Fatal("next cell could outlive prior cleanup or streams")
				}
				if request.Action != "inventory" || strings.Contains(process.input.String(), `"action":"create"`) || strings.Contains(process.input.String(), `"action":"remove"`) {
					t.Fatal("diagnostic mutated mappings")
				}
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(host.args[:len(host.args)-1], []string{"-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-EncodedCommand"}) {
					t.Fatal("diagnostic changed launch flags")
				}
				inputHashes = append(inputHashes, execution.Diagnostic.InputSHA256)
				return execution.Diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed
			})
			want := []string{"01_entry_open", "02_entry_eof", "03_inventory_open", "04_inventory_eof", "05_resolve_json_command", "06_import_utility_parse"}
			if failCleanupAt != 0 {
				want = want[:failCleanupAt]
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(names, want) || starts != len(want) || aborted != (failCleanupAt != 0) || failures < 1 {
				t.Fatalf("cell admission: names=%v starts=%d aborted=%v failures=%d", names, starts, aborted, failures)
			}
			if failCleanupAt == 0 && (preparations != 1 || failures != 2) || failCleanupAt != 0 && preparations != 0 {
				t.Fatal("late import preparation ran before admission or clean resolution failure blocked it")
			}
			wantMappingChecks := 2
			if failCleanupAt == 2 {
				wantMappingChecks = 0
			}
			if mappingChecks != wantMappingChecks {
				t.Fatal("inventory preparation escaped its admitted cell")
			}
			for _, hash := range inputHashes {
				if hash != inputHashes[0] {
					t.Fatal("request bytes changed between cells")
				}
			}
		})
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"ReadLine", "$input", "Import-Module", "Get-SmbMapping", "WindowsIdentity", "|"} {
		if strings.Contains(mappingStartupEntryScript, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("entry-only script gained %s", forbidden)
		}
	}
}

func TestMappingStartupOriginalScriptsUnchanged(t *testing.T) {
	manifest := "/fixture/modules/Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility/Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility.psd1"
	importUTF8, importUTF16 := "30599cdbe8e9be12f0eb2302da4920460323f2337bae6037334582048057d1b6", "a76c9ea76b802b4d138f68bdace233a8ff9f5ea7ccf85f27310154d2781a493b"
	if filepath.Separator == '\\' {
		manifest = `C:\fixture\modules\Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility\Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility.psd1`
		importUTF8, importUTF16 = "597389a69c2dc8bdd65d0dfb6c22e62cd74af2961cad67f38001890791fcd99f", "a6c9a22dcfad6041824b27420f575e0c304c521abf629fea3aae7d815fec9af7"
	}
	importScript, err := mappingStartupImportScript(manifest)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name, script, utf8Hash, utf16Hash string
		units                             int
	}{
		{"entry", mappingStartupEntryScript, "35832e1ac6f9fced065027493bc3faeeae304d06106463a728437a95c1328999", "136335e08a760524367812d41bc9362ad286105bb37a9661fdeb8ec6b21f09c7", 105},
		{"resolve", mappingStartupResolveScript, "d20270905eb2314e1ca8d98a67c5adf2822bf2c2de2d5fffb80c7233ba156ca8", "69edafeb1fd24fce0060b65a0d07778bc5f620bbff53e57a6d99ac2799c60f99", 5272},
		{"import-parse", importScript, importUTF8, importUTF16, 6297},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			words := utf16.Encode([]rune(test.script))
			encoded := make([]byte, 2*len(words))
			for index, word := range words {
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(encoded[2*index:], word)
			}
			if len(words) != test.units || fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(test.script))) != test.utf8Hash || fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(encoded)) != test.utf16Hash {
				t.Fatal("an original diagnostic script changed while adding post-failure controls")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingStartupResultKinds(t *testing.T) {
	request := mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", OwnerSID: mappingBaselineForTest().Owner.SID}
	inventory, err := json.Marshal(mappingCommandResult{Status: "ok", OwnerSID: request.OwnerSID, Rows: []mappingRow{}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, cell := range mappingStartupPlan() {
		t.Run(cell.Name, func(t *testing.T) {
			valid := []byte(cell.Result + "\r\n")
			if cell.Kind == mappingStartupInventory {
				valid = append(append([]byte(nil), inventory...), '\n')
			}
			if err := validateMappingStartupResult(cell, valid, request); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("correct cell-specific result rejected: %v", err)
			}
			for _, invalid := range [][]byte{nil, []byte(`{"status":"wrong-kind"}`), append(append([]byte(nil), valid...), []byte(`{"extra":true}`)...)} {
				if err := validateMappingStartupResult(cell, invalid, request); err == nil {
					t.Fatal("cell accepted missing, foreign or trailing output")
				}
			}
			forged := cell
			forged.Result = `{"status":"forged"}`
			forgedOutput := []byte(forged.Result)
			if cell.Kind == mappingStartupInventory {
				forgedOutput = inventory
			}
			if err := validateMappingStartupResult(forged, forgedOutput, request); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("cell accepted a reforged expected result")
			}
			unknown := cell
			unknown.Kind = mappingStartupKind("unknown")
			if err := validateMappingStartupResult(unknown, valid, request); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("unknown cell kind selected a fallback validator")
			}
			if cell.Kind == mappingStartupInventory {
				foreign := request
				foreign.OwnerSID = "different-owner"
				if err := validateMappingStartupResult(cell, inventory, foreign); err == nil {
					t.Fatal("inventory kind bypassed ordinary owner validation")
				}
			} else if err := validateMappingStartupResult(cell, inventory, request); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("fixed-result control accepted an inventory receipt")
			}
		})
	}
}

func mappingStartupManifestForTest(t *testing.T, name string) string {
	t.Helper()
	path, err := filepath.Abs(filepath.Join("command-control-fixture", name))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return path
}

func TestMappingStartupManifestPathEncoding(t *testing.T) {
	for _, path := range []string{
		mappingStartupManifestForTest(t, "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility.psd1"),
		mappingStartupManifestForTest(t, "literal'quoted;`$name-模块🧪.psd1"),
	} {
		script, err := mappingStartupImportScript(path)
		if err != nil || script == "" {
			t.Fatal("absolute manifest path did not produce an import control")
		}
		encoded := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(path))
		if strings.Count(script, encoded) != 1 || strings.Contains(script, path) || !strings.Contains(script, "[Convert]::FromBase64String('"+encoded+"')") {
			t.Fatal("manifest path was interpolated as PowerShell syntax or lost its single encoded binding")
		}
		decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(encoded)
		if err != nil || string(decoded) != path {
			t.Fatal("manifest path did not preserve its UTF-8 bytes")
		}
		if strings.Count(script, "$request = $requestLine | ConvertFrom-Json") != 1 || strings.Contains(script, "Get-Command") {
			t.Fatal("import control replaced its original JSON pipeline or added discovery")
		}
	}
	for _, invalid := range []string{"", "relative.psd1", `C:relative.psd1`, `\root-relative.psd1`, "C:\\invalid\x00.psd1", "C:\\invalid\xff.psd1"} {
		if script, err := mappingStartupImportScript(invalid); err == nil || script != "" {
			t.Fatal("invalid manifest path produced an executable or fallback script")
		}
	}
}

const mappingUtilityImportForTest = `$utilityModules = @(Microsoft.PowerShell.Core\Import-Module -Name $utilityManifest -PassThru -ErrorAction Stop)`

const mappingUtilityModuleGuardForTest = `if ($utilityModules.Count -ne 1 -or $utilityModules[0] -isnot [System.Management.Automation.PSModuleInfo] -or $utilityModules[0].Name -cne 'Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility') {
        throw 'Utility import did not return exactly the expected module.'
    }`

const mappingUtilityJSONGuardForTest = `if ($null -eq $jsonCommand -or $jsonCommand -isnot [System.Management.Automation.CmdletInfo] -or $jsonCommand.Name -cne 'ConvertFrom-Json' -or $jsonCommand.CommandType -ne [System.Management.Automation.CommandTypes]::Cmdlet) {
        throw 'Utility module did not export the expected JSON cmdlet.'
    }`

func mappingUtilityImportOrder(source string) error {
	return mappingObservationOrder(source, "$requestLine = [Console]::In.ReadLine()", "Write-RfsEnvironmentObservation",
		"$rfsObservationStage = 'operation'", "$utilityManifest = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String('",
		"'RFS-MAPPING/1 before-utility'", mappingUtilityImportForTest+"\n    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 after-utility')",
		mappingUtilityModuleGuardForTest, "$jsonCommand = $utilityModules[0].ExportedCmdlets['ConvertFrom-Json']", mappingUtilityJSONGuardForTest,
		"'RFS-MAPPING/1 before-json'", "$request = $requestLine | & $jsonCommand\n    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 after-json')",
		"Import-Module -Name $request.module -ErrorAction Stop")
}

func TestMappingUtilityExportObjectBinding(t *testing.T) {
	const export = "$jsonCommand = $utilityModules[0].ExportedCmdlets['ConvertFrom-Json']"
	const invoke = "$request = $requestLine | & $jsonCommand"
	if err := mappingUtilityImportOrder(mappingPowerShell); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, statement := range []string{mappingUtilityImportForTest, mappingUtilityModuleGuardForTest, export, mappingUtilityJSONGuardForTest, invoke} {
		if strings.Count(mappingPowerShell, statement) != 1 {
			t.Fatal("mapping does not retain exactly one guarded imported JSON cmdlet")
		}
	}
	for _, mutation := range []struct {
		name, before, after string
	}{
		{"module-cardinality", "$utilityModules.Count -ne 1 -or ", ""},
		{"module-type", "$utilityModules[0] -isnot [System.Management.Automation.PSModuleInfo] -or ", ""},
		{"module-name", " -or $utilityModules[0].Name -cne 'Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility'", ""},
		{"module-refusal", "throw 'Utility import did not return exactly the expected module.'", "$null = 'Utility import did not return exactly the expected module.'"},
		{"export-before-module-guard", mappingUtilityModuleGuardForTest + "\n    " + export, export + "\n    " + mappingUtilityModuleGuardForTest},
		{"wrong-module-export", export, "$jsonCommand = $utilityModules[1].ExportedCmdlets['ConvertFrom-Json']"},
		{"wrong-export-name", export, "$jsonCommand = $utilityModules[0].ExportedCmdlets['ConvertTo-Json']"},
		{"null-export", "$null -eq $jsonCommand -or ", ""},
		{"export-type", "$jsonCommand -isnot [System.Management.Automation.CmdletInfo] -or ", ""},
		{"export-name", "$jsonCommand.Name -cne 'ConvertFrom-Json' -or ", ""},
		{"export-command-kind", " -or $jsonCommand.CommandType -ne [System.Management.Automation.CommandTypes]::Cmdlet", ""},
		{"export-refusal", "throw 'Utility module did not export the expected JSON cmdlet.'", "$null = 'Utility module did not export the expected JSON cmdlet.'"},
		{"invoke-before-export-guard", mappingUtilityJSONGuardForTest + "\n    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 before-json')\n    " + invoke, "[Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 before-json')\n    " + invoke + "\n    " + mappingUtilityJSONGuardForTest},
		{"unqualified-name", invoke, "$request = $requestLine | ConvertFrom-Json"},
		{"module-qualified-name", invoke, `$request = $requestLine | Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility\ConvertFrom-Json`},
		{"object-name-substitution", invoke, "$request = $requestLine | & $jsonCommand.Name"},
		{"string-object-substitution", invoke, "$request = $requestLine | & ([string]$jsonCommand)"},
		{"rediscovered-target", invoke, "$request = $requestLine | & (Get-Command ConvertFrom-Json)"},
		{"wrong-object", invoke, "$request = $requestLine | & $utilityModules[0]"},
	} {
		t.Run(mutation.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			source := strings.Replace(mappingPowerShell, mutation.before, mutation.after, 1)
			if source == mappingPowerShell || mappingUtilityImportOrder(source) == nil {
				t.Fatal("exact exported-object binding control accepted its targeted mutation")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingUtilityImportBuilderBindsVerifiedPath(t *testing.T) {
	const placeholder = "__RFS_UTILITY_MANIFEST_BASE64__"
	for _, path := range []string{mappingStartupManifestForTest(t, "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility.psd1"), mappingStartupManifestForTest(t, "quoted'-$name-模块🧪.psd1")} {
		script, err := mappingPowerShellScript(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		encoded := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(path))
		if strings.Count(script, encoded) != 1 || strings.Contains(script, placeholder) || strings.Contains(script, path) || strings.Replace(script, encoded, placeholder, 1) != mappingPowerShell {
			t.Fatal("mapping builder changed more than its single encoded manifest binding")
		}
		if err := mappingUtilityImportOrder(script); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		withoutImport := strings.Replace(script, mappingUtilityImportForTest, "", 1)
		if withoutImport == script || mappingUtilityImportOrder(withoutImport) == nil {
			t.Fatal("explicit import omission escaped its source control")
		}
		withoutSuppression := strings.Replace(script, mappingUtilityImportForTest, `Microsoft.PowerShell.Core\Import-Module -Name $utilityManifest -PassThru -ErrorAction Stop`, 1)
		if mappingUtilityImportOrder(withoutSuppression) == nil {
			t.Fatal("successful import output could contaminate the mapping result")
		}
	}
	for _, invalid := range []string{"", "Utility.psd1", `C:relative.psd1`, "C:\\invalid\x00.psd1", "C:\\invalid\xff.psd1"} {
		if script, err := mappingPowerShellScript(invalid); script != "" || err == nil {
			t.Fatal("mapping builder accepted an unverified path or supplied a fallback")
		}
	}
	buildFailure, closeFailure := errors.New("script builder failed"), errors.New("builder cleanup failed")
	file := &mappingUtilityTestFile{reader: strings.NewReader(mappingUtilityTestData), info: mappingUtilityTestInfo{size: int64(len(mappingUtilityTestData))}, closeErr: closeFailure}
	ops := mappingUtilityOpsForTest()
	ops.Open = func(string) (mappingUtilityFile, error) { return file, nil }
	ops.CommandLine = func([]string) string { t.Fatal("failed builder reached command-line preparation"); return "" }
	script, facts, err := prepareMappingUtility(context.Background(), mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), "system-powershell", func(string) (string, error) { return "", buildFailure }, ops)
	if script != "" || !errors.Is(err, buildFailure) || !errors.Is(err, closeFailure) || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), buildFailure.Error()) || facts.CleanupConfirmed || file.closes != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("builder failure or cleanup cause was lost: facts=%+v error=%v", facts, err)
	}
}

func TestMappingCommandControlScriptOperations(t *testing.T) {
	importScript, err := mappingStartupImportScript(mappingStartupManifestForTest(t, "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility.psd1"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, script := range []string{mappingStartupResolveScript, importScript} {
		for _, helper := range []string{"Get-RfsCommandTextFact", "Write-RfsCommandFact", "Format-RfsCommandText", "Write-RfsCommandUnsupported", "Write-RfsCommandProvenance"} {
			if strings.Count(script, "function "+helper) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("control lost its bounded diagnostic helper: %s", helper)
			}
		}
		for _, forbidden := range []string{"Get-SmbMapping", "New-SmbMapping", "Remove-SmbMapping", "ConvertTo-Json", "ReadToEnd", "$input", ".Parameters", ".ParameterSets", ".Definition", ".ExportedCommands", "SetEnvironmentVariable"} {
			if strings.Contains(script, forbidden) {
				t.Fatalf("control added an out-of-scope operation: %s", forbidden)
			}
		}
		if strings.Count(script, "$requestLine = [Console]::In.ReadLine()") != 1 || !strings.HasSuffix(script, mappingCommandFailure) {
			t.Fatal("control changed its one-line input or shared failed-result path")
		}
		if err := mappingObservationOrder(script,
			"$implementingType = $Command.ImplementingType", "$assembly = $implementingType.Assembly",
			"$mvid = $implementingType.Module.ModuleVersionId.ToString('D')",
			"$moduleName = $null", "$moduleVersion = $null", "$modulePath = $null", "if ($null -ne $Module)"); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	const resolution = `Microsoft.PowerShell.Core\Get-Command -Name ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop`
	if strings.Count(mappingStartupResolveScript, resolution) != 1 || strings.Contains(mappingStartupResolveScript, "Import-Module") || strings.Contains(mappingStartupResolveScript, "$request = $requestLine | ConvertFrom-Json") {
		t.Fatal("resolution control changed its exact query or invoked JSON conversion")
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{" -All", " -ArgumentList", " -CommandType"} {
		if strings.Contains(mappingStartupResolveScript, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("resolution control changed command selection: %s", forbidden)
		}
	}
	if err := mappingObservationOrder(mappingStartupResolveScript,
		"'RFS-CMD/1 entry resolve'", "$requestLine = [Console]::In.ReadLine()", "$rfsCommandStage = 'resolve'",
		"'RFS-CMD/1 before-resolution'", resolution, "'RFS-CMD/1 after-resolution'", "if ($commands.Count -ne 1",
		"$rfsCommandStage = 'provenance'", "'RFS-CMD/1 before-provenance'",
		"Write-RfsCommandProvenance $commands[0] $commands[0].Module 'resolved-command'",
		"'RFS-CMD/1 after-provenance'", "$rfsCommandStage = 'result'",
		`[Console]::Out.WriteLine('{"status":"resolve-ok"}')`, "'RFS-CMD/1 complete resolve'"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	const importCommand = `Microsoft.PowerShell.Core\Import-Module -Name $utilityManifest -PassThru -ErrorAction Stop`
	if strings.Count(importScript, importCommand) != 1 || strings.Contains(importScript, " -Force") || strings.Contains(importScript, "Get-Command") {
		t.Fatal("import control changed its explicit import or added rediscovery")
	}
	if err := mappingObservationOrder(importScript,
		"'RFS-CMD/1 entry import-parse'", "$requestLine = [Console]::In.ReadLine()", "$utilityManifest =",
		"$rfsCommandStage = 'import'", "'RFS-CMD/1 before-import'", importCommand, "'RFS-CMD/1 after-import'",
		"if ($modules.Count -ne 1", "$rfsCommandStage = 'provenance'", "'RFS-CMD/1 before-provenance'",
		"$command = $modules[0].ExportedCmdlets['ConvertFrom-Json']", "if ($null -eq $command",
		"Write-RfsCommandProvenance $command $modules[0] 'imported-export'", "'RFS-CMD/1 after-provenance'",
		"$rfsCommandStage = 'parse'", "'RFS-CMD/1 before-parse'", "$request = $requestLine | ConvertFrom-Json",
		"'RFS-CMD/1 after-parse'", "$rfsCommandStage = 'result'",
		`[Console]::Out.WriteLine('{"status":"import-parse-ok"}')`, "'RFS-CMD/1 complete import-parse'"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := mappingObservationOrder(mappingCommandFailure,
		"catch {\n    $primaryError = $_\n    $primaryStage = $rfsCommandStage", "try {",
		"'RFS-CMD/1 error-begin stage={0}'", "Get-RfsCommandTextFact $primaryError.Exception.GetType().FullName 64",
		"Get-RfsCommandTextFact $primaryError.FullyQualifiedErrorId 64", "'RFS-CMD/1 error-end'",
		"} catch {", "'RFS-CMD/1 observer-failure'", "} finally {", "exit 1"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func mappingReplyChild(reply string) *mappingCommandChild {
	p := &mappingCommandChild{input: &mappingInputBuffer{}, output: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(reply)), stderr: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("")), done: make(chan struct{})}
	close(p.done)
	return p
}

func TestMappingCommandUsesOwnedProcessAndSingleLineInput(t *testing.T) {
	sid := mappingBaselineForTest().Owner.SID
	data, _ := json.Marshal(mappingCommandResult{Status: "ok", OwnerSID: sid, Rows: []mappingRow{}})
	process := mappingReplyChild(string(data))
	host := &mappingCommandHost{child: process}
	parentEnvironment := append([]string(nil), os.Environ()...)
	request := mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", Module: "system-module", OwnerSID: sid}
	result, err := runMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), host, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), request, mappingUtilityOpsForTest())
	if err != nil || result.Status != "ok" {
		t.Fatalf("command: %#v %v", result, err)
	}
	if host.cache != "NUL" || !reflect.DeepEqual(parentEnvironment, os.Environ()) {
		t.Fatal("module cache was not isolated and restored")
	}
	if process.finished != 1 || process.input.closes != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("owner/pipe closed incorrectly: %d/%d", process.finished, process.input.closes)
	}
	input := process.input.String()
	if !strings.HasSuffix(input, "\n") || strings.Count(input, "\n") != 1 {
		t.Fatal("request is not one JSON line")
	}
	var decoded mappingCommandRequest
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &decoded); err != nil || decoded != request {
		t.Fatal("request changed")
	}
	encoded := host.args[len(host.args)-1]
	raw, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(encoded)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	words := make([]uint16, len(raw)/2)
	for i := range words {
		words[i] = binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(raw[2*i:])
	}
	wantScript, err := mappingPowerShellScript(filepath.Join(mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility", "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility.psd1"))
	if err != nil || string(utf16.Decode(words)) != wantScript {
		t.Fatal("launched PowerShell differs from bound source")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(mappingPowerShell, "ReadLine()") || strings.Contains(mappingPowerShell, "ReadToEnd()") || strings.Contains(mappingPowerShell, "UseWriteThrough") {
		t.Fatal("mapping changed input ownership or ordinary cache behavior")
	}
}

func TestMappingCommandCancellationJoinsOwnedWorkers(t *testing.T) {
	outReader, outWriter := io.Pipe()
	errReader, errWriter := io.Pipe()
	process := &mappingCommandChild{input: &mappingInputBuffer{}, output: outReader, stderr: errReader, done: make(chan struct{}), forced: true}
	var once sync.Once
	process.closePipes = func() { once.Do(func() { outWriter.Close(); errWriter.Close(); close(process.done) }) }
	host := &mappingCommandHost{child: process}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	_, err := runMappingPowerShell(ctx, host, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", OwnerSID: mappingBaselineForTest().Owner.SID}, mappingUtilityOpsForTest())
	if !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "forced") || process.finished != 1 || process.input.closes != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("canceled command ownership: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestMappingCommandCannotReportMalformedOrForcedSuccess(t *testing.T) {
	sid := mappingBaselineForTest().Owner.SID
	for _, reply := range []string{`{"status":"ok","owner_sid":"` + sid + `","cause":""}`, `{"status":"ok","owner_sid":"wrong","rows":[],"cause":""}`, `{"status":"ok","owner_sid":"` + sid + `","rows":[],"cause":"failed"}`, `{"status":"ok","owner_sid":"` + sid + `","rows":[],"cause":"","extra":1}`} {
		child := mappingReplyChild(reply)
		host := &mappingCommandHost{child: child}
		if _, err := runMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), host, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), mappingCommandRequest{OwnerSID: sid}, mappingUtilityOpsForTest()); err == nil || child.finished != 1 {
			t.Fatal("invalid command receipt passed")
		}
	}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(mappingCommandResult{Status: "ok", OwnerSID: sid, Rows: []mappingRow{}})
	child := mappingReplyChild(string(raw))
	child.forced = true
	if _, err := runMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), &mappingCommandHost{child: child}, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), mappingCommandRequest{OwnerSID: sid}, mappingUtilityOpsForTest()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("forced cleanup became success")
	}
}

func TestMappingTokenStatisticsABI(t *testing.T) {
	var value mappingTokenStatistics
	if unsafe.Sizeof(value) != 56 || unsafe.Alignof(value) != 8 || unsafe.Offsetof(value.AuthenticationID) != 8 || unsafe.Offsetof(value.Expiration) != 16 || unsafe.Offsetof(value.ModifiedID) != 48 {
		t.Fatal("TOKEN_STATISTICS differs from the Windows 64-bit ABI")
	}
}

type mappingTestDeadline struct{ context.Context }

func (c mappingTestDeadline) Err() error {
	if c.Context.Err() != nil {
		return context.DeadlineExceeded
	}
	return nil
}

type mappingDiagnosticInput struct {
	write func([]byte) (int, error)
	close func() error
}

func (w mappingDiagnosticInput) Write(data []byte) (int, error) { return w.write(data) }
func (w mappingDiagnosticInput) Close() error                   { return w.close() }

type mappingDiagnosticReader struct {
	data                          []byte
	ready, release, ended         chan struct{}
	readyOnce, closeOnce, endOnce sync.Once
}

func newMappingDiagnosticReader(data string) *mappingDiagnosticReader {
	return &mappingDiagnosticReader{data: []byte(data), ready: make(chan struct{}), release: make(chan struct{}), ended: make(chan struct{})}
}
func (r *mappingDiagnosticReader) Read(data []byte) (int, error) {
	if len(r.data) > 0 {
		n := copy(data, r.data)
		r.data = r.data[n:]
		if len(r.data) == 0 {
			r.readyOnce.Do(func() { close(r.ready) })
		}
		return n, nil
	}
	r.readyOnce.Do(func() { close(r.ready) })
	<-r.release
	r.endOnce.Do(func() { close(r.ended) })
	return 0, io.EOF
}
func (r *mappingDiagnosticReader) Close() error {
	r.closeOnce.Do(func() { close(r.release) })
	return nil
}

func mappingDiagnosticFrom(t *testing.T, err error) *mappingDiagnosticError {
	t.Helper()
	var diagnostic *mappingDiagnosticError
	if !errors.As(err, &diagnostic) {
		t.Fatalf("missing bounded mapping diagnostic: %v", err)
	}
	if len(diagnostic.Error()) >= 16<<10 {
		t.Fatal("diagnostic exceeded 16 KiB")
	}
	return diagnostic
}

func mappingDiagnosticPrefix(t *testing.T, stream mappingStreamDiagnostic) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(stream.PrefixBase64)
	if err != nil || len(data) > mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit {
		t.Fatalf("invalid bounded stream prefix: bytes=%d error=%v", len(data), err)
	}
	return data
}

func TestMappingTimeoutDiagnosticFollowsOwnerAndWorkerCompletion(t *testing.T) {
	for _, blocked := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "written-input"
		if blocked {
			name = "blocked-input"
		}
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			base, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			ctx := mappingTestDeadline{Context: base}
			out := newMappingDiagnosticReader("observed stdout bytes")
			stages := "RFS-MAPPING/1 entry\nRFS-MAPPING/1 before-import\n"
			stderr := newMappingDiagnosticReader(stages)
			inputClosed := make(chan struct{})
			closes := 0
			process := &mappingCommandChild{output: out, stderr: stderr, done: make(chan struct{}), forced: true}
			process.inputOverride = mappingDiagnosticInput{write: func(data []byte) (int, error) {
				<-out.ready
				<-stderr.ready
				cancel()
				if blocked {
					<-inputClosed
					return 0, io.ErrClosedPipe
				}
				return len(data), nil
			}, close: func() error { closes++; close(inputClosed); return nil }}
			cleanupFailure := errors.New("owned cleanup failure")
			process.finishErr = cleanupFailure
			process.closePipes = func() { close(process.done) }
			_, err := runMappingPowerShell(ctx, &mappingCommandHost{child: process}, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", OwnerSID: mappingBaselineForTest().Owner.SID}, mappingUtilityOpsForTest())
			if !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || !errors.Is(err, cleanupFailure) || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), context.DeadlineExceeded.Error()+"\n") {
				t.Fatalf("first/cleanup error chain changed: %v", err)
			}
			if process.finished != 1 || closes != 1 || process.resultCalls != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("owner/result calls: finishes=%d closes=%d result=%d", process.finished, closes, process.resultCalls)
			}
			for _, reader := range []*mappingDiagnosticReader{out, stderr} {
				select {
				case <-reader.ended:
				default:
					t.Fatal("diagnostic returned before reader finished")
				}
			}
			d := mappingDiagnosticFrom(t, err).details
			if d.Action != "inventory" || d.PID == nil || *d.PID != 55 || d.PreCleanupDone == nil || *d.PreCleanupDone || d.PreCleanupResult != nil || d.ElapsedMillis < 0 {
				t.Fatalf("unobserved exit or PID facts: %+v", d)
			}
			if !d.WriteStarted || !d.WriteReturned || d.WriteComplete == blocked {
				t.Fatalf("input completion facts: %+v", d)
			}
			if blocked {
				if d.WriteBytes != 0 || d.WriteError != io.ErrClosedPipe.Error() {
					t.Fatalf("blocked write was hidden: %+v", d)
				}
			} else if d.WriteBytes != d.InputBytes || d.WriteError != "" {
				t.Fatalf("completed write bytes changed: %+v", d)
			}
			if string(mappingDiagnosticPrefix(t, d.Stdout)) != "observed stdout bytes" || d.Stdout.ObservedBytes != int64(len("observed stdout bytes")) || d.Stdout.PrefixTruncated {
				t.Fatalf("stdout observations changed: %+v", d.Stdout)
			}
			if string(mappingDiagnosticPrefix(t, d.Stderr)) != stages || d.Stderr.ObservedBytes != int64(len(stages)) || d.Stderr.PrefixTruncated {
				t.Fatalf("stderr stages lost: %+v", d.Stderr)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingWriteFailureDiagnosticsRetainActualProgress(t *testing.T) {
	sid := mappingBaselineForTest().Owner.SID
	reply, _ := json.Marshal(mappingCommandResult{Status: "ok", OwnerSID: sid, Rows: []mappingRow{}})
	for _, partial := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "failed"
		if partial {
			name = "partial"
		}
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			process := mappingReplyChild(string(reply))
			failure := errors.New("input write failed")
			resultFailure := errors.New("child exited before cleanup")
			process.result = resultFailure
			closes := 0
			process.inputOverride = mappingDiagnosticInput{write: func(data []byte) (int, error) {
				if partial {
					return len(data) - 1, nil
				}
				return 0, failure
			}, close: func() error { closes++; return nil }}
			_, err := runMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), &mappingCommandHost{child: process}, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", OwnerSID: sid}, mappingUtilityOpsForTest())
			want := failure
			if partial {
				want = io.ErrShortWrite
			}
			if !errors.Is(err, want) || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), want.Error()+"\n") {
				t.Fatalf("write cause lost: %v", err)
			}
			d := mappingDiagnosticFrom(t, err).details
			if d.PID == nil || *d.PID != 55 || d.PreCleanupDone == nil || !*d.PreCleanupDone || d.PreCleanupResult == nil || *d.PreCleanupResult != resultFailure.Error() {
				t.Fatalf("known exit was omitted: %+v", d)
			}
			if !d.WriteReturned || d.WriteComplete || d.WriteError != want.Error() || process.finished != 1 || closes != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("write completion/ownership differs: %+v", d)
			}
			if partial && d.WriteBytes != d.InputBytes-1 || !partial && d.WriteBytes != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("write count invented: %+v", d)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMappingStartupFailureDoesNotInventPIDOrIO(t *testing.T) {
	failure := errors.New("process startup failed")
	host := &mappingCommandHost{startErr: failure}
	_, err := runMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), host, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory"}, mappingUtilityOpsForTest())
	if !errors.Is(err, failure) || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), failure.Error()+"\n") {
		t.Fatalf("startup cause replaced: %v", err)
	}
	d := mappingDiagnosticFrom(t, err).details
	if d.PID != nil || d.PreCleanupDone != nil || d.PreCleanupResult != nil || d.WriteStarted || d.WriteReturned || d.WriteComplete || d.WriteBytes != 0 || d.Stdout.ObservedBytes != 0 || d.Stderr.ObservedBytes != 0 || host.starts != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("startup invented child facts: %+v", d)
	}
}
