func TestMappingFailureCaptureIsBoundedAndDoesNotExposeFullStderr(t *testing.T) {
	sid := mappingBaselineForTest().Owner.SID
	process := mappingReplyChild("not-json")
	secretTail := "stderr-tail-outside-retained-prefix"
	stderr := strings.Repeat("x", mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit+1) + secretTail
	process.stderr = io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(stderr))
	_, err := runMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), &mappingCommandHost{child: process}, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", OwnerSID: sid}, mappingUtilityOpsForTest())
	diagnostic := mappingDiagnosticFrom(t, err)
	if strings.Contains(err.Error(), secretTail) || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "PowerShell stderr:") {
		t.Fatal("malformed stdout exposed unbounded stderr")
	}
	d := diagnostic.details
	if d.Stderr.ObservedBytes != int64(len(stderr)) || !d.Stderr.PrefixTruncated || !bytes.Equal(mappingDiagnosticPrefix(t, d.Stderr), []byte(stderr[:mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit])) {
		t.Fatalf("stderr prefix/count incorrect: %+v", d.Stderr)
	}
	if d.PreCleanupDone == nil || !*d.PreCleanupDone || d.PreCleanupResult == nil || *d.PreCleanupResult != "" {
		t.Fatalf("observed successful Result was not retained: %+v", d)
	}
	long := strings.Repeat("\x00", 4096)
	action, actionTruncated := mappingDiagnosticText(long, 64)
	writeError, writeTruncated := mappingDiagnosticText(long, 512)
	resultError, resultTruncated := mappingDiagnosticText(long, 512)
	stream := mappingStreamDiagnostic{ObservedBytes: 1 << 30, PrefixBase64: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(make([]byte, mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit)), PrefixTruncated: true}
	maximal := mappingCommandDiagnostic{Action: action, ActionTruncated: actionTruncated, PreCleanupResult: &resultError, PreCleanupResultTruncated: resultTruncated, WriteError: writeError, WriteErrorTruncated: writeTruncated, InputLineBytes: 4095, InputLineSHA256: strings.Repeat("a", 64), InputBytes: 4096, InputSHA256: strings.Repeat("b", 64), Stdout: stream, Stderr: stream}
	manifestSize := int64(mappingByteLimit)
	maximal.UtilityPreparation = &mappingUtilityPreparation{Path: strings.Repeat("p", 1024), Size: &manifestSize, ReadBytes: mappingByteLimit, SHA256: strings.Repeat("c", 64), CleanupConfirmed: true}
	bounded := mappingDiagnosticFrom(t, encodeMappingDiagnostic(maximal))
	if !bounded.details.ActionTruncated || !bounded.details.WriteErrorTruncated || !bounded.details.PreCleanupResultTruncated || !reflect.DeepEqual(bounded.details.UtilityPreparation, maximal.UtilityPreparation) {
		t.Fatal("bounded text omitted its truncation facts")
	}
}

type mappingReadOnlyReader struct{ io.Reader }

func TestMappingCaptureCopyCannotBypassTheOutputBound(t *testing.T) {
	var capture mappingBoundedBuffer
	input := strings.Repeat("x", mappingByteLimit+16)
	n, err := io.Copy(&capture, mappingReadOnlyReader{strings.NewReader(input)})
	if err == nil || n != mappingByteLimit || capture.Len() != mappingByteLimit {
		t.Fatalf("io.Copy bypassed output bound: n=%d captured=%d err=%v", n, capture.Len(), err)
	}
	d := capture.diagnostic()
	if d.ObservedBytes != int64(len(input)) || !d.PrefixTruncated || string(mappingDiagnosticPrefix(t, d)) != input[:mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit] {
		t.Fatalf("read/write observations invented a complete stream: %+v", d)
	}
	var single mappingBoundedBuffer
	if _, err := single.Write([]byte(input)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("oversized writer input was accepted")
	}
	if d := single.diagnostic(); d.ObservedBytes != int64(len(input)) || len(mappingDiagnosticPrefix(t, d)) != mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit || single.Len() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("rejected write lost its observed prefix: %+v", d)
	}
}

func mappingOperationStagesForTest() []string {
	return []string{"entry", "before-readline", "after-readline", "before-utility", "after-utility", "before-json", "after-json", "before-owner", "after-owner", "before-import", "after-import", "before-inventory", "after-inventory", "before-create-inventory", "after-create-inventory", "before-remove-inventory", "after-remove-inventory", "after-result"}
}

func mappingObservationOrder(source string, fragments ...string) error {
	for _, fragment := range fragments {
		index := strings.Index(source, fragment)
		if index < 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("missing or out-of-order observation anchor: %s", fragment)
		}
		source = source[index+len(fragment):]
	}
	return nil
}

func mappingObservationOwnership(source string) error {
	const catchStart = "} catch {\n    $primaryError = $_\n    $primaryOrigin = $rfsObservationStage"
	index := strings.Index(source, catchStart)
	if index < 0 {
		return errors.New("operation catch does not immediately retain the primary ErrorRecord and stage")
	}
	return mappingObservationOrder(source[index:], catchStart,
		"'RFS-MAPPING/1 catch-entry'", "'RFS-MAPPING/1 obs-begin catch'",
		"$primaryError.Exception.GetType().FullName", "$primaryError.FullyQualifiedErrorId",
		"'RFS-MAPPING/1 obs-end catch'", "} catch {", "'RFS-MAPPING/1 obs-failure catch'",
		"} finally {", "$cause = $primaryError.Exception.Message",
		"if ($cause.Length -gt 1024) { $cause = $cause.Substring(0,1024) }",
		"[ordered]@{ status = 'error'; owner_sid = $owner; rows = @(); cause = $cause } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress", "exit 1")
}

func TestMappingObservationScriptOwnershipAndOrder(t *testing.T) {
	for _, helper := range []string{"Get-RfsBoundedTextFact", "Write-RfsInputObservation", "Write-RfsEnvironmentObservation"} {
		if strings.Count(mappingPowerShell, "function "+helper) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("missing or repeated observation helper: %s", helper)
		}
	}
	textStart := strings.Index(mappingPowerShell, "function Get-RfsBoundedTextFact")
	inputStart := strings.Index(mappingPowerShell, "function Write-RfsInputObservation")
	environmentStart := strings.Index(mappingPowerShell, "function Write-RfsEnvironmentObservation")
	operationStart := strings.Index(mappingPowerShell, "try {\n    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 before-readline')")
	if textStart < 0 || inputStart <= textStart || environmentStart <= inputStart || operationStart <= environmentStart {
		t.Fatal("observation helper boundaries changed")
	}
	textHelper := mappingPowerShell[textStart:inputStart]
	inputHelper := mappingPowerShell[inputStart:environmentStart]
	environmentHelper := mappingPowerShell[environmentStart:operationStart]
	if err := mappingObservationOrder(textHelper,
		"if ($null -eq $Value) { return @{ state = 'null' } }", "$text = [string]$Value",
		"$head = $text.Substring(0, [Math]::Min($text.Length, $Limit + 1))", "$bytes = $utf8.GetBytes($head)",
		"$retained = [Math]::Min($bytes.Length, $Limit)", "[Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes, 0, $retained)"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := mappingObservationOrder(inputHelper,
		"if ($null -eq $Value)", "'RFS-MAPPING/1 obs-input state=null'", "$text = [string]$Value",
		"if ($text.Length -gt 4096)", "throw 'Input observation exceeds its UTF-16 limit.'",
		"$length = $utf8.GetByteCount($text)", "if ($length -gt 12288)", "throw 'Input observation exceeds its UTF-8 limit.'",
		"$bytes = $utf8.GetBytes($text)", "[Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()", "$hash.ComputeHash($bytes)",
		"if ($null -ne $hash) { $hash.Dispose() }", "read_line_utf8_sha256={3}"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := mappingObservationOrder(environmentHelper,
		"foreach ($name in @('PSModulePath', 'WinPSModulePath', 'PSModuleAnalysisCachePath'))",
		"$value = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name, [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::Process)",
		"$fact = Get-RfsBoundedTextFact $value 96"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if strings.Count(environmentHelper, "GetEnvironmentVariable(") != 1 {
		t.Fatal("environment observation no longer snapshots each allowlisted value once")
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"ConvertFrom-Json", "ConvertTo-Json", "Import-Module", "Get-Command", "Get-Module", "SetEnvironmentVariable", "ReadLine", "ReadToEnd"} {
		if strings.Contains(mappingPowerShell[textStart:operationStart], forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("observation helpers added operational work: %s", forbidden)
		}
	}
	if err := mappingObservationOrder(mappingPowerShell,
		"$requestLine = [Console]::In.ReadLine()", "'RFS-MAPPING/1 after-readline'",
		"$rfsObservationStage = 'input'", "Write-RfsInputObservation $requestLine",
		"$rfsObservationStage = 'environment'", "Write-RfsEnvironmentObservation",
		"$rfsObservationStage = 'operation'", "$utilityManifest =", "'RFS-MAPPING/1 before-utility'",
		mappingUtilityImportForTest, "'RFS-MAPPING/1 after-utility'", mappingUtilityModuleGuardForTest,
		"$jsonCommand = $utilityModules[0].ExportedCmdlets['ConvertFrom-Json']", mappingUtilityJSONGuardForTest, "'RFS-MAPPING/1 before-json'",
		"$request = $requestLine | & $jsonCommand", "'RFS-MAPPING/1 after-json'",
		"$owner = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().User.Value",
		"Import-Module -Name $request.module -ErrorAction Stop"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := mappingObservationOwnership(mappingPowerShell); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, stage := range []string{"input", "environment", "catch"} {
		for _, kind := range []string{"obs-begin", "obs-end", "obs-failure"} {
			if strings.Count(mappingPowerShell, "'RFS-MAPPING/1 "+kind+" "+stage+"'") != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("missing or repeated observation boundary: %s %s", kind, stage)
			}
		}
	}
	if strings.Count(mappingPowerShell, "$requestLine =") != 1 || strings.Count(mappingPowerShell, "$request = $requestLine | & $jsonCommand") != 1 ||
		strings.Contains(mappingPowerShell, "$request = $requestLine | ConvertFrom-Json") ||
		strings.Count(mappingPowerShell, "ConvertTo-Json") != 2 || strings.Contains(mappingPowerShell, "$cause = $_.") {
		t.Fatal("observation changed the input, JSON commands or primary cause ownership")
	}
	for _, mutation := range []struct {
		name, source string
	}{
		{"discard-primary", strings.Replace(mappingPowerShell, "$primaryError = $_", "$primaryError = $null", 1)},
		{"catch-marker-after-serialization", strings.Replace(strings.Replace(mappingPowerShell, "[Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 catch-entry')", "", 1), "    exit 1", "    [Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 catch-entry')\n    exit 1", 1)},
		{"secondary-overwrites-cause", strings.Replace(mappingPowerShell, "$cause = $primaryError.Exception.Message", "$cause = $_.Exception.Message", 1)},
		{"serialization-outside-finally", strings.Replace(mappingPowerShell, "} finally {\n        $cause = $primaryError.Exception.Message", "}\n        $cause = $primaryError.Exception.Message", 1)},
	} {
		t.Run(mutation.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if mutation.source == mappingPowerShell || mappingObservationOwnership(mutation.source) == nil {
				t.Fatal("observation ownership control accepted its targeted mutation")
			}
		})
	}
}

func mappingScriptFormatForTest(t *testing.T, source, prefix string, values ...string) string {
	t.Helper()
	needle := "'" + prefix
	if strings.Count(source, needle) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("record format is missing or ambiguous: %s", prefix)
	}
	start := strings.Index(source, needle) + 1
	format, _, found := strings.Cut(source[start:], "'")
	if !found {
		t.Fatal("record format has no closing quote")
	}
	for index, value := range values {
		format = strings.ReplaceAll(format, fmt.Sprintf("{%d}", index), value)
	}
	if strings.ContainsAny(format, "{}") {
		t.Fatalf("record format has unbound fields: %s", prefix)
	}
	return format
}

func mappingObservationFormatForTest(t *testing.T, prefix string, values ...string) string {
	t.Helper()
	return mappingScriptFormatForTest(t, mappingPowerShell, prefix, values...)
}

func TestMappingCommandControlStderrGrammarBound(t *testing.T) {
	script, err := mappingStartupImportScript(mappingStartupManifestForTest(t, "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility.psd1"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if strings.Count(script, "RFS-CMD/1 ") != 19 || strings.Count(mappingStartupResolveScript, "RFS-CMD/1 ") != 17 {
		t.Fatal("control record inventory changed without a new byte accounting")
	}
	record := func(prefix string, values ...string) string {
		return mappingScriptFormatForTest(t, script, "RFS-CMD/1 "+prefix, values...) + "\r\n"
	}
	const maximumLength = "2147483647"
	textFields := func(name string, limit int) string {
		prefix := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(bytes.Repeat([]byte{'x'}, limit))
		return mappingScriptFormatForTest(t, script, "{0}_state={1}", name, "value", maximumLength, prefix, "1")
	}
	var provenance strings.Builder
	provenance.WriteString(record("command role={", "resolved-command"))
	for _, fact := range []struct {
		name, expression string
		limit            int
	}{
		{"module_name", "$moduleName", 64}, {"module_version", "$moduleVersion", 48}, {"module_path", "$modulePath", 96},
		{"implementing_type", "$implementingType.FullName", 96}, {"assembly_name", "$assembly.FullName", 112}, {"assembly_location", "$assembly.Location", 96},
	} {
		call := fmt.Sprintf("Write-RfsCommandFact '%s' %s %d", fact.name, fact.expression, fact.limit)
		if strings.Count(mappingCommandPrelude, call) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("provenance field or prefix cap changed: %s", fact.name)
		}
		prefix := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(bytes.Repeat([]byte{'x'}, fact.limit))
		provenance.WriteString(record("fact name={0} state={1}", fact.name, "value", maximumLength, prefix, "1"))
	}
	provenance.WriteString(record("mvid value={", "ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff"))
	var stages strings.Builder
	for _, stage := range []string{"entry import-parse", "before-readline", "after-readline", "before-import", "after-import", "before-provenance", "after-provenance", "before-parse", "after-parse", "complete import-parse"} {
		stages.WriteString(record(stage))
	}
	var resolveStages strings.Builder
	for _, stage := range []string{"entry resolve", "before-readline", "after-readline", "before-resolution", "after-resolution", "before-provenance", "after-provenance", "complete resolve"} {
		resolveStages.WriteString(mappingScriptFormatForTest(t, mappingStartupResolveScript, "RFS-CMD/1 "+stage) + "\r\n")
	}
	if resolveStages.Len() > stages.Len() {
		t.Fatal("resolution stages exceed the selected combined stage bound")
	}
	failure := record("error-begin stage={", "provenance") + record("error-end") + record("observer-failure") + record("error {", textFields("type", 64), textFields("id", 64))
	maximum := provenance.String() + stages.String() + failure
	unsupported := stages.String() + record("unsupported count={", maximumLength, textFields("name", 64), textFields("kind", 32)) + failure
	if len(maximum) != 2008 || len(unsupported) != 935 || len(maximum) > mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit || len(unsupported) > mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit {
		t.Fatalf("control grammar exceeds its declared bounds: provenance=%d unsupported=%d limit=%d", len(maximum), len(unsupported), mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit)
	}
	for _, output := range []string{maximum, unsupported} {
		for _, value := range output {
			if value > 127 {
				t.Fatal("control record contains unencoded variable text")
			}
		}
		var buffer mappingBoundedBuffer
		if n, err := buffer.Write([]byte(output)); err != nil || n != len(output) {
			t.Fatal("control record did not fit the unchanged capture")
		}
		diagnostic := buffer.diagnostic()
		if diagnostic.PrefixTruncated || string(mappingDiagnosticPrefix(t, diagnostic)) != output {
			t.Fatal("generated control records were truncated within the declared budget")
		}
	}
	nullField := func(name string) string {
		return mappingScriptFormatForTest(t, script, "{0}_state=null", name)
	}
	for _, output := range []string{
		record("fact name={0} state=null", "module_path"),
		record("unsupported count={", "0", nullField("name"), nullField("kind")),
		record("error {", nullField("type"), nullField("id")),
	} {
		if strings.Contains(output, "16=") || strings.Contains(output, "_b64=") || strings.Contains(output, "cut=") {
			t.Fatal("null control fact invented length or prefix observations")
		}
	}
}

func TestMappingObservationStderrGrammarBound(t *testing.T) {
	record := func(prefix string, values ...string) string {
		return mappingObservationFormatForTest(t, "RFS-MAPPING/1 "+prefix, values...) + "\r\n"
	}
	var legacy strings.Builder
	for _, stage := range mappingOperationStagesForTest() {
		legacy.WriteString(record(stage))
	}
	if legacy.Len() != 551 {
		t.Fatalf("eighteen operation marker bytes changed: %d", legacy.Len())
	}
	const maximumLength = "2147483647"
	environmentPrefix := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(bytes.Repeat([]byte{'x'}, 96))
	errorPrefix := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(bytes.Repeat([]byte{'x'}, 64))
	if len(environmentPrefix) != 128 || len(errorPrefix) != 88 {
		t.Fatal("base64 prefix budget changed")
	}
	typeFields := mappingObservationFormatForTest(t, "type_state={", "value", maximumLength, errorPrefix, "1")
	idFields := mappingObservationFormatForTest(t, "id_state={", "value", maximumLength, errorPrefix, "1")
	catch := record("catch-entry") + record("obs-begin catch") + record("obs-catch origin={", "environment", typeFields, idFields) + record("obs-end catch")
	var failures strings.Builder
	for _, stage := range []string{"input", "environment", "catch"} {
		failures.WriteString(record("obs-failure " + stage))
	}
	var bounded strings.Builder
	bounded.WriteString(legacy.String())
	bounded.WriteString(record("obs-begin input"))
	bounded.WriteString(record("obs-input state={", "value", "4096", "12288", strings.Repeat("f", 64)))
	bounded.WriteString(record("obs-end input"))
	bounded.WriteString(record("obs-begin environment"))
	for _, name := range []string{"PSModulePath", "WinPSModulePath", "PSModuleAnalysisCachePath"} {
		bounded.WriteString(record("obs-env name={0} state={", name, "value", maximumLength, environmentPrefix, "1"))
	}
	bounded.WriteString(record("obs-end environment"))
	bounded.WriteString(catch)
	bounded.WriteString(failures.String())
	if bounded.Len() != 2040 || bounded.Len() > mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit {
		t.Fatalf("actual record grammar exceeds its declared prefix budget: bytes=%d limit=%d", bounded.Len(), mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit)
	}
	for _, value := range bounded.String() {
		if value > 127 {
			t.Fatal("record grammar emitted unencoded variable text")
		}
	}
	var captured mappingBoundedBuffer
	if n, err := captured.Write([]byte(bounded.String())); err != nil || n != bounded.Len() {
		t.Fatalf("bounded records were not fully captured: bytes=%d error=%v", n, err)
	}
	diagnostic := captured.diagnostic()
	if diagnostic.PrefixTruncated || diagnostic.ObservedBytes != int64(bounded.Len()) || string(mappingDiagnosticPrefix(t, diagnostic)) != bounded.String() {
		t.Fatal("record grammar lost observations within the existing stderr prefix")
	}
	for _, limit := range []string{
		record("obs-input-limit utf16={0} utf8=unmeasured", maximumLength),
		record("obs-input-limit utf16={0} utf8={1}", "4096", maximumLength),
	} {
		early := legacy.String() + record("obs-begin input") + limit + catch + failures.String()
		if len(early) > mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit || len(early) >= bounded.Len() {
			t.Fatal("early input-limit failure exceeds the record budget")
		}
	}
	for _, nullRecord := range []string{
		record("obs-input state=null"),
		record("obs-env name={0} state=null", "PSModulePath"),
		record("obs-catch origin={", "operation", mappingObservationFormatForTest(t, "type_state=null"), mappingObservationFormatForTest(t, "id_state=null")),
	} {
		if strings.Contains(nullRecord, "utf16=") || strings.Contains(nullRecord, "utf8=") || strings.Contains(nullRecord, "sha256=") || strings.Contains(nullRecord, "_b64=") || strings.Contains(nullRecord, "16=") {
			t.Fatal("null record manufactured a length, prefix or digest")
		}
	}
}

func TestMappingStageMarkersKeepSuccessReceiptUnchanged(t *testing.T) {
	for _, stage := range mappingOperationStagesForTest() {
		marker := "[Console]::Error.WriteLine('RFS-MAPPING/1 " + stage + "')"
		if strings.Count(mappingPowerShell, marker) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("missing or repeated fixed stderr stage: %s", stage)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(mappingPowerShell, "ReadToEnd") || strings.Contains(mappingPowerShell, "[Console]::In.Close") || strings.Contains(mappingPowerShell, "$input") {
		t.Fatal("diagnostic changed stdin protocol")
	}
	sid := mappingBaselineForTest().Owner.SID
	want := mappingCommandResult{Status: "ok", OwnerSID: sid, Rows: []mappingRow{}}
	data, _ := json.Marshal(want)
	process := mappingReplyChild(string(data))
	process.stderr = io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("RFS-MAPPING/1 entry\nRFS-MAPPING/1 after-result\n"))
	result, err := runMappingPowerShell(context.Background(), &mappingCommandHost{child: process}, "system-powershell", "private-evidence", mappingUtilityRootForTest(t), mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", OwnerSID: sid}, mappingUtilityOpsForTest())
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(result, want) || process.finished != 1 || process.input.closes != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("normal result/owner changed: result=%+v err=%v", result, err)
	}
}
